description: Two listings head to head, as on /compare/: the score in every category for both, which one leads each by how much or whether they're level, the evidence behind each edge, what each is good for, the facts side by side (transport, auth, pricing, x402, tools exposed, latest release), the verdicts and the notes for agents. Use it when a user weighs two named tools against each other. Pairs that don't do the same job get a short answer saying why. format markdown (default), slim (fewest tokens) or json.

a.description: One listing's slug, e.g. exa-mcp (search_tools finds slugs), or a package or repository name it goes by

b.description: The other listing's slug, e.g. tavily-mcp

format.description: markdown (the default), slim for the fewest tokens, or json

name: compare_tools
title: Compare two listings
